day_shape: 102 items: US-Iran MoU 60-day clock starts with CENTCOM lifting Iran port blockade and Khamenei's office posting reluctant approval, four IDF soldiers killed in south Lebanon as IDF strikes 80+ Hezbollah targets, Treasury sanctions Hezbollah-aligned Lebanese officials.

threads.label: US-Iran MoU enters 60-day window
threads.summary: VP Vance said the 60-day MoU period began 18 June, with Vance outlining that a final deal would bar enrichment, destroy enriched stocks and cap missile ranges, while CENTCOM announced US forces lifted the maritime blockade on Iranian ports. Iran International reported Tehran will invite IAEA and US inspectors to identify enriched material sites, and Tanker Trackers logged ~18m barrels of Iranian crude exported over five days.

threads.label: Khamenei's office publishes reluctant approval
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted the full text of a message to the Iranian nation saying he held "another view in principle" but granted permission based on the President's commitment, with follow-up posts warning that future face-to-face talks do not mean accepting the enemy's view. Pezeshkian, Qalibaf and the IRGC issued responses pledging to implement the Leader's directives, and the National Security Council Secretariat said reciprocal action would follow any US violation.

threads.label: Pushback on the MoU in Washington and Israel
threads.summary: Republican senators including Tom Cotton criticised the agreement, with one calling it the "worst foreign policy blunder in decades" and Cotton warning that sanctions relief on Iranian oil could earn Tehran $200m a day, while Jewish groups also voiced opposition. VP Vance publicly defended the deal against criticism from ministers Smotrich and Ben-Gvir, and former Navy commander Eliezer Marom said Israel must prepare for possible escalation with Tehran.

threads.label: South Lebanon flare-up after IDF deaths
threads.summary: The IDF announced four soldiers were killed in southern Lebanon, including 401st Brigade 52nd Battalion commander Lt. Col. Dor Gedalia Ben Simhon, with five more wounded in a separate Hezbollah explosive-drone attack at Kfar Tebnit. In response Israel said it struck over 80 Hezbollah targets across southern Lebanon and the Bekaa, killing dozens of operatives; Yisrael Beiteinu's Liberman called for strikes on Dahiyeh and France's foreign minister urged Israel to halt violations.

threads.label: US sanctions Hezbollah-aligned network
threads.summary: The State Department announced designations of two Hezbollah-aligned Lebanese officials and members of a business network overseen by previously-designated Alaa Hassan Hamieh. Spokesperson Tommy Pigott said the officials had used their influence to undermine the authority of the Lebanese state.

threads.label: Pakistan delegation for Khamenei funeral
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported that Pakistani PM Shehbaz Sharif told the National Assembly he would head a high-level delegation to Tehran on 3-4 July for the funeral procession of Ayatollah Khamenei. The channels said the invitation was issued by Iran's President.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire and humanitarian situation
threads.summary: The UN Security Council heard that despite a limited Gaza ceasefire millions still face daily hardship, with speakers demanding unhindered aid access and respect for the peace plan. Israel's High Court ordered the state to justify weeks-long pre-judicial detention of Gaza detainees, and a former hostage described sexual abuse in Hamas captivity to First Lady Michal Herzog.

The teams are expected to convene again next week.
